caption:
Comment SUPPS for your free supplement check 💊

People are cutting their food shop to pay for supplements an influencer told them to buy.

Bupa's 2026 research found 60% of people who buy supplements recommended on social media fund them by cutting back on groceries, clothes or eating out.

I'm not against supplements. I just think the basics come first, and none of these five cost more than a pack of gummies.

Have you ever bought something because an influencer swore by it?

Save this for your next big shop, and send it to the friend with a cupboard full of gummies.
